name: Winzerhof Stahl
dinnerNote: 9 courses, sold only with the wine pairing (price includes wine, water and coffee)
dinnerNoteDe: 9 Gänge, nur mit Weinbegleitung (inklusive Wein, Wasser und Kaffee)
lunchNote: Same menu, with wine, at lunch · Saturdays
lunchNoteDe: Gleiches Menü mit Wein am Mittag · Samstag

menus.name: nine-course menu with wines
menus.note: Sold only with its wine pairing: price includes the estate's wines, water and espresso; lunch on Saturdays at 12pm or dinner Wednesday to Saturday from 6pm; vegetarian or pescatarian version for genuine vegetarians on request

bookingOpens: Online on OpenTable, or by phone or email (reservieren@winzerhof-stahl.de). Booking is required; there are no walk-ins.
walkIns: None: the restaurant serves only guests who have booked.
groups: Weddings and events of up to 135 guests are held in the estate's barn, April to December; ask by phone or email (mail@winzerhof-stahl.de).
duration: Several hours; the restaurant describes it as an evening-long experience.
